definition: Five independent contexts per source/375/1440px/50/500notes, AB/BA order. Five native theme-button clicks each; first and repeat samples separate. Capture-phase mark to first renderer Paint in same PID; not physical presentation or INP. Tracing perturbs timings. Handler and 2rAF proxy and saved indicator measured separately. Exact state reloaded. Each sample verifies theme, body mode, meta color, actual background and card count. Performance runs are serialized, no other browser measurement runs concurrently. Event Timing click matched by event timestamp: inputDelayMs before dispatch, processingMs, quantized8ms duration. Minimum16ms reporting threshold; missing entry = null, not zero. This controlled sample is not field INP.
